name: Scapholunate Advanced Collapse Wrist
definition: Predictable pattern of wrist osteoarthritis developing after chronic scapholunate ligament insufficiency and carpal malalignment.

typical: History of old ligament injury may exist

investigations.principle: Radiographs define staged radioscaphoid/capitolunate degeneration; CT is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent advanced disease may require proximal row carpectomy or partial/total wrist fusion depending on stage.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha Sandhigata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Predictable pattern of wrist osteoarthritis developing after chronic scapholunate ligament insufficiency and carpal malalignment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
